WITH base AS (
SELECT
  analytics_retained_totals.region AS "analytics_retained_totals.region", MEASURE(analytics_retained_totals.total) AS "analytics_retained_totals.total", MEASURE(analytics_retained_totals.count) AS "analytics_retained_totals.count", MEASURE(analytics_retained_totals.minimum) AS "analytics_retained_totals.minimum", MEASURE(analytics_retained_totals.maximum) AS "analytics_retained_totals.maximum"
  FROM analytics_retained_totals
  WHERE analytics_retained_totals.id < '0'
  GROUP BY 1
  HAVING MEASURE(analytics_retained_totals.total) > '0'
)
SELECT
  base."analytics_retained_totals.region" AS "analytics_retained_totals.region", base."analytics_retained_totals.total" AS "analytics_retained_totals.total", base."analytics_retained_totals.count" AS "analytics_retained_totals.count", base."analytics_retained_totals.minimum" AS "analytics_retained_totals.minimum", base."analytics_retained_totals.maximum" AS "analytics_retained_totals.maximum"
  FROM base
  ORDER BY "analytics_retained_totals.region"
  LIMIT 1

  FROM analytics_retained_totals
  WHERE analytics_retained_totals.id < '0'
  GROUP BY 1
  HAVING MEASURE(analytics_retained_totals.total) > '0') AS retained
cases.oracleSql:
WITH grouped AS (SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS total, COUNT(*) AS count,
    MIN(amount) AS minimum, MAX(amount) AS maximum FROM analytics_retained_totals
    WHERE channel='keep' AND id < 0 GROUP BY region HAVING SUM(amount) > 0)
    SELECT  SUM(total) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(count),0) AS count,
      MIN(minimum) AS minimum, MAX(maximum) AS maximum FROM grouped
